topic: Viewing and Editing Processed Salary (Salary Summary Month Wise)
summary: After salaries are processed, this module allows you to view a summary of all processed salaries for a given month and make specific, one-time adjustments to individual employee salaries.
steps: Select the 'Year' and 'Month' for which you want to view salaries.
Click 'Go' (leaving employee selection blank will show all employees for the month).
Review the list displaying employee IDs, names, departments, designations, payable days, gross salary, deduction amount, and paid salary.
To make changes to a specific employee's salary, click the 'View' option corresponding to that employee.
The complete salary structure for that employee and month will open.

To add a deduction (e.g., 'Advance Recovery'): Locate the 'Advance Recovery' head (or add it if not present) and enter the 'Amount' (e.g., 11,000). The system will automatically recalculate gross, deduction, and paid salary.
To change an existing earning or deduction amount (e.g., 'Basic'): Edit the amount directly in the respective field.
Enter 'Remarks' explaining the changes made (e.g., 'Advance recovery added'). This step is mandatory for saving changes.
Click 'Save'. A pop-up will confirm that the changes have been saved.
You can view the employee's salary again to confirm the changes.
business_rules: Changes made in 'Salary Summary Month Wise' are specific to the selected month's salary and do not alter the employee's assigned contract (salary template) for future months.
Entering 'Remarks' is mandatory when saving any changes to a processed salary.
important_notes: This is the primary place for making month-specific adjustments like deducting advances, fines, or adding one-time bonuses.
If a required earning or deduction head is not available, it must first be created in 'Payroll Master' under 'HRM Setup'.
